label: popstats
external_renderer: window.renderPopstatsPage — defined in js/atlas_page6_wiring.js (NOT inlined in legacy)
purpose: Per-window popstats track stack for the active chromosome. Stack of population-genetic canvas tracks aligned to the chromosome — |Z|/score, SNP density, BEAGLE imputation uncertainty, depth/coverage, theta_pi, F_ST (between karyotype groups), Hobs/Hexp, ancestry Δ12 (top-1 minus top-2 Q).
required_layers: candidate_gene_cargo (REGISTRY MISMATCH — page is chromosome-level, not candidate-level)
actually_consumed_layers: popstats_tracks (likely; via popstats live server endpoint)
required_slots: activeCandidate (REGISTRY MISMATCH — page is chromosome-level; should be activeChrom)
primitives_used: unknown — external renderer in js/atlas_page6_wiring.js handles everything

interactions.purpose: click chips in #psChips to toggle track visibility

computed_preview_outputs: popstats track stack: |Z|/score, SNP density, BEAGLE uncertainty, depth, theta_pi, F_ST, Hobs/Hexp, ancestry Δ12
known_issues: REGISTRY MISMATCH (flagged 2026-05-07 step 18): page is chromosome-level (driven by per-window metrics keyed on activeChrom + group_set_id) but requires_layers/requires_slots declare candidate-level values. Round-18 was migration-only, didn't change registry.
External renderer in js/atlas_page6_wiring.js is loaded via typeof-guard dispatch; if absent the page shows missing-renderer empty-state.
